_comment: AP-6 (815-autopilot-remediation-router.md) — I1's routing table, literal, as the design doc's own words name it: 'маршрутная таблица (детерминированная, config/autopilot/routing.json)'. Single source of truth for scripts/autopilot/autopilot_common.py's ROUTE_CLASS/ROUTING (loaded at import, never re-typed as a second dict). LAW (C0.6, M, J1): no kind may carry route_class AUTO or AUTO_NO_MODEL for a money-shaped fact — enforced at LOAD TIME in _load_routing() (fails closed, not just checked once in a test) and again in incident-cli.py --selftest as a test on ABSENCE.
_fields: route_class: AUTO (fleet task, model spend, REVIEW as given) | AUTO_NO_MODEL (engine self-action, zero model, zero fleet task) | MIXED (engine self-action + a diagnostic-only fleet task) | HUMAN_KEY (WAITING_HUMAN via the existing connected_db.py key contour, bridged by AP-6) | HUMAN_ONLY (money/CAPTCHA/etc — WAITING_HUMAN + operator file, no autobranch ever) | HUMAN_GENERIC (WAITING_HUMAN + operator file, unclassifiable). review: fable|opus|none|null (null = no fleet task is ever generated for this kind, so REVIEW is meaningless). T-0140 Ч-3 (2026-09-21, Fable ruling-1): opus is the cheaper THIRD tier taskloop.sh's REVIEW: opus branch reads — read-only diagnosis (PROVIDER_DOWN/DEGRADED_QUALITY, haiku-executed) and narrow adapter/probe-config edits (API_CHANGED/ENDPOINT_CHANGED, sonnet-executed, gated by taskloop.sh's own REVIEW_TIER_ALLOWLIST) — never a silent downgrade: taskloop.sh escalates any opus-tier task straight to fable the moment its diff leaves the allowlist, a prior ruling already exists for it, prior-art search says 'covered', or the tier has REJECTed it twice. EMAIL_NOTICE stays fable unconditionally — an inbound provider email is untrusted input that can claim a price/ToS change, i.e. money-and-public-claims-shaped, never the cheap tier's job. fleet_task: whether route_auto_incidents() ever files a taskloop/queue/ file for this kind. model: haiku|sonnet, REQUIRED iff fleet_task is true, FORBIDDEN on every HUMAN_* route_class (enforced at load time, T-07/B2, Fable ruling-1) — which model taskloop.sh's MODEL: header tells the exec/arbiter step to run. haiku: the task is read-only diagnosis (curl a probe URL, read probe_log/next_recheck_at, verdict is 'still waiting on the provider', no code changes). sonnet: the task edits an adapter/parser and needs tests. fable/opus are never assigned here — they are the arbiter/reviewer (REVIEW: field), never the executor of a fleet task. T-0265 (REMEDIATION-MODEL-1005 ruling-1): two-phase remediation — for PROVIDER_DOWN/DEGRADED_QUALITY/QUOTA_LOW/QUOTA_EXHAUSTED (autopilot_common.PHASE_A_KINDS) `model: haiku` is PHASE A: measure + one of incident-cli wait | propose-fix | BLOCKED, never a commit (MAX_ATTEMPTS 2); the sonnet PHASE B fix task is filed by incident-engine ONLY from a propose-fix note, REVIEW as given here, MAX_ATTEMPTS 4, diff limited to taskloop's REVIEW_TIER_ALLOWLIST. API_CHANGED/ENDPOINT_CHANGED/EMAIL_NOTICE stay single-phase. The model/review/route_class values themselves are unchanged.
_merchant: T-INT-13 (§12.2): 12 merchant:* kinds. No money kind is AUTO/AUTO_NO_MODEL (the four HUMAN_ONLY ones carry fleet_task=false, model=null; enforced at load time by autopilot_common._load_routing). variants = three deterministic options for the TG 'Варианты:' line and the operator file; target_agent = 'Кому передать ответ:'; escalate_after_hours/escalate_to = AUTO_NO_MODEL -> HUMAN_GENERIC after that age (WEBHOOK_FAILED 72h, REFUND_OVERDUE/DISPUTE_UNANSWERED 7d); template = outbound-mail template queued by the engine (INT-18 sends). MODERATION_FLAG is HUMAN_GENERIC per §12.2 ('flag — операторский файл').
